active_phases.name: Relicense & Agent-Capture Retirement
active_phases.objective: Relicense vocky from AGPL-3.0 to MIT and retire the MCP/agent-decided capture feature — remove the MCP server wiring, tools, config, and related docs — refocusing the product on human-triggered REST feedback as the base for the SaaS pivot.

active_phases.name: Accounts, Tenancy & Projects Core
active_phases.objective: Replace static env-var bearer-token auth with real user accounts (signup/login) and introduce the multi-tenant SaaS core: tenants, projects, and per-project credentials. Free service — no paid plans or billing.

active_phases.name: Feedback API v2, Search & Usage Monitoring
active_phases.objective: Expose a full tenant/project-scoped REST API over feedback (capture plus get/list/manage) so external services' admin panels can consume feedback directly; add proper feedback search across a user's projects and per-tenant/project usage monitoring.

active_phases.name: Agent-Capture Revival (MCP write-only)
active_phases.objective: Reintroduce the retired agent-decided feedback capture as a write-only MCP surface: agents linked to a project's Vocky MCP endpoint save user feedback at their own judgement via a single capture_feedback tool, feeding the same feedback queue/store as REST. Scoped by P2 per-project credentials and aligned with P3's v2 capture shape; the three retired read tools stay retired.

active_phases.name: Web App: Tenant Dashboard & Project Pages
active_phases.objective: Build the authenticated web app — tenant dashboard and project detail pages — in a new Next.js app (hi2vi_web-style), replacing the packaged operator admin UI.

active_phases.name: Design Gate: Brand, App UI & Landing
active_phases.objective: Run the Claude Design gate for vocky's brand, the app UI and the landing: write the handoff, hold the operator's design session, read the design back, and land the signed-off design as an implementable spec. Implementation is P9.

active_phases.name: Apply the Design: App UI, Landing & Feature Changes
active_phases.objective: Implement P8's signed-off design across the app and the landing page, from the gate's build-prompt.md — foundation first, net-new capabilities isolated, backend reopened where the design requires it, closing with a design-fidelity fix and a consistency/DoD sweep.

active_phases.name: CLI & Agent-First Onboarding
active_phases.objective: Ship a vocky CLI so a user can sign up, log in, and configure credentials from Claude Code or Codex, with agent-readable help/guide docs so vocky is fully usable without visiting the website.

active_phases.name: Landing Page, Webpage & Production Deploy
active_phases.objective: Build the public landing page/site in the Next.js app using the hi2vi_web Claude design-gate workflow, and deploy to production at vocky.hi2vi.com — app on the oracle-cloud box, nginx via edge.
